relatively.en: This method requires relatively little training data to produce reliable results.
relatively.zh: 这种方法只需要相对少量的训练数据就能产生可靠的结果。

relatively.en: The two theories are relatively consistent with observations recorded in the field.
relatively.zh: 这两个理论与野外记录到的观测结果相对一致。

relatively.en: Compared with traditional methods, the new approach is relatively inexpensive.
relatively.zh: 与传统方法相比，这种新方法相对便宜。

reportedly.en: The experimental results were reportedly confirmed by two independent laboratories.
reportedly.zh: 据报道，这些实验结果已由两个独立的实验室确认。

reportedly.en: Sales in the region reportedly fell by twelve percent during the first quarter.
reportedly.zh: 据报道，该地区第一季度的销售额下降了 12%。

reportedly.en: The species reportedly survived decades without any recorded human contact.
reportedly.zh: 据报道，该物种在没有任何记录在案的人类接触的情况下存续了数十年。

sharply.en: House prices in major cities rose sharply during the first half of the year.
sharply.zh: 今年上半年大城市的房价急剧上涨。

sharply.en: The curve shows a sharply defined boundary between the two research groups.
sharply.zh: 该曲线显示出两个研究群体之间清晰的界限。

sharply.en: The minister sharply criticized the proposal as financially unrealistic.
sharply.zh: 部长严厉地批评该提案，称其在财政上不切实际。

simply.en: The argument is simply too weak to support such a strong conclusion.
simply.zh: 这个论据实在太薄弱，无法支撑如此有力的结论。

simply.en: She simply ignored the invitation and continued working through the evening.
simply.zh: 她干脆无视了邀请，继续工作到晚上。

simply.en: You can simply follow the standard procedure for every routine request.
simply.zh: 对于每项常规请求，你只需按照标准程序处理即可。

somewhat.en: The results were somewhat surprising, given the assumptions of the original model.
somewhat.zh: 考虑到原模型的假设，这些结果多少有些出人意料。

somewhat.en: Our understanding of early language development remains somewhat limited.
somewhat.zh: 我们对早期语言发展的理解仍然有些局限。

somewhat.en: Prices have decreased somewhat since the beginning of the trading year.
somewhat.zh: 自交易年度开始以来，价格已略有下降。

specifically.en: The study focuses specifically on rural households with limited internet access.
specifically.zh: 该研究专门关注上网条件受限的农村家庭。

specifically.en: Please clarify specifically which data sources were used in the analysis.
specifically.zh: 请具体说明分析中使用了哪些数据来源。

specifically.en: This drug is approved specifically for treating chronic inflammation in adults.
specifically.zh: 这种药物获批专门用于治疗成年人的慢性炎症。

steadily.en: Enrollment in the program has grown steadily over the past five years.
steadily.zh: 该项目的入学人数在过去五年中稳步增长。

steadily.en: She steadily reduced her monthly spending to build an emergency fund.
steadily.zh: 她稳步减少每月开支，以积累应急资金。

steadily.en: The readings moved steadily closer to the predicted value during the experiment.
steadily.zh: 在实验过程中，读数逐步接近预测值。

subsequently.en: The proposal was revised twice and subsequently approved by the ethics committee.
subsequently.zh: 该提案经过两次修改，随后获得了伦理委员会的批准。

subsequently.en: Temperatures rose sharply and subsequently fell back to normal levels.
subsequently.zh: 气温急剧上升，随后又回落到正常水平。

subsequently.en: Several researchers attempted to replicate the finding but were subsequently unable to.
subsequently.zh: 几位研究者试图复现该发现，但随后未能成功。

surely.en: The evidence is strong, so the researchers are surely correct.
surely.zh: 证据足够充分，研究人员肯定是对的。

surely.en: Surely, no reasonable reader would accept such a careless argument.
surely.zh: 当然，没有哪个理智的读者会接受如此草率的论证。

surely.en: We can surely improve the outcome by revising the experimental procedure.
surely.zh: 通过修订实验步骤，我们肯定能改善结果。

therefore.en: The sample was too small, and therefore the conclusion must remain tentative.
therefore.zh: 样本量太小，因此结论必须保持暂定状态。

therefore.en: The two variables are strongly correlated; therefore, one cannot be ignored.
therefore.zh: 这两个变量高度相关，因此其中一个不能被忽略。

therefore.en: Funding was withdrawn, and therefore the entire project was suspended.
therefore.zh: 经费被撤回，因此整个项目被暂停。

thus.en: Additional data are required, and thus the analysis will be extended.
thus.zh: 需要更多数据，因此分析工作将延长。

thus.en: The phenomenon was first observed in laboratories, thus supporting its scientific credibility.
thus.zh: 该现象最初在实验室中被观察到，从而增强了其科学可信度。

thus.en: The model is simplified for clarity, thus reducing the burden on readers.
thus.zh: 该模型为了清晰而作了简化，从而减轻了读者的负担。

typically.en: Graduate students typically submit their thesis proposals during the spring term.
typically.zh: 研究生通常在春季学期提交论文开题报告。

typically.en: This species typically migrates between the coast and the inland wetlands.
typically.zh: 该物种通常在海岸与内陆湿地之间迁徙。

typically.en: Participants typically spent between two and three hours completing the questionnaire.
typically.zh: 参与者通常花两到三个小时完成问卷。

widely.en: The findings have been widely cited in journals across several disciplines.
widely.zh: 这些研究结果已在多个学科的期刊中被广泛引用。

widely.en: Such a policy is widely supported among economists working on public finance.
widely.zh: 这样的政策在研究公共财政的经济学家中得到广泛支持。

widely.en: The technique is now widely used in laboratories throughout the country.
widely.zh: 该技术如今已在全国各地的实验室中被广泛使用。

although.en: Although the sample was limited, the pattern appeared consistent across all sites.
although.zh: 尽管样本有限，这一模式在所有地点都表现出一致性。

although.en: The method is expensive, although it produces highly accurate measurements.
although.zh: 这种方法成本高昂，尽管它能产生非常精确的测量结果。

although.en: Although few participants volunteered, their responses were notably detailed.
although.zh: 虽然自愿参加的人不多，但他们的回答非常详细。

because.en: The results were replicated because the original experiment had been carefully controlled.
because.zh: 结果得到了复现，因为最初的实验得到了严格控制。

because.en: Funding was withdrawn because the committee questioned the project's methodology.
because.zh: 经费被撤回，因为委员会质疑该项目的方法。

because.en: The model was revised because earlier assumptions did not hold in practice.
because.zh: 该模型被修订，因为先前的假设在实践中并不成立。

besides.en: Besides offering better accuracy, the new system also reduces processing time.
besides.zh: 除了提高准确率之外，新系统还缩短了处理时间。

besides.en: Besides the cost, there are several practical obstacles to wider adoption.
besides.zh: 除了成本之外，还有若干妨碍更广泛采用的实际障碍。

besides.en: The design is faster; besides, it is cheaper to maintain.
besides.zh: 这一设计速度更快，此外维护成本也更低。

but.en: The intervention was highly effective, but its long-term benefits remain uncertain.
but.zh: 这种干预非常有效，但其长期效益仍不确定。

but.en: She submitted the report on time, but forgot to attach the supporting data.
but.zh: 她按时提交了报告，却忘了附上支持数据。

but.en: The theory is elegant, but it does not explain the observed exceptions.
but.zh: 该理论很精巧，却无法解释观察到的例外情况。

however.en: The intervention reduced costs; however, it required extensive staff training.
however.zh: 该干预降低了成本，然而需要进行大量员工培训。

however.en: However promising the early results appear, further trials are clearly necessary.
however.zh: 无论早期结果看来多么有希望，显然仍需进一步的试验。

however.en: The reviewer raised concerns; however, the manuscript was finally accepted.
however.zh: 审稿人提出了疑虑，然而该稿件最终被接受了。

moreover.en: Moreover, the revised design reduces both cost and processing time substantially.
moreover.zh: 此外，修订后的设计大幅降低了成本和处理时间。

moreover.en: The study covers multiple regions; moreover, it compares two distinct modeling approaches.
moreover.zh: 该研究涵盖多个地区，此外还比较了两种不同的建模方法。

moreover.en: Moreover, the new policy offers incentives for firms to invest in research.
moreover.zh: 再者，新政策为企业投资研发提供了激励。

so.en: The device malfunctioned, so the experiment was repeated the following week.
so.zh: 设备出了故障，因此实验在下一周重新进行。

so.en: Funding was insufficient, so the team reduced the scope of the study.
so.zh: 经费不足，因此团队缩小了研究的范围。

so.en: She asked several questions, so the instructor repeated the central argument.
so.zh: 她提了几个问题，因此讲师重复了核心论点。

though.en: Though the hypothesis seemed plausible, subsequent experiments rejected it entirely.
though.zh: 尽管这个假设看起来合理，随后的实验却完全否定了它。

though.en: The program has expanded rapidly, though its long-term funding remains unclear.
though.zh: 该项目扩张迅速，但其长期资金来源仍不清楚。

though.en: It is expensive, though the resulting accuracy is impressive for industrial use.
though.zh: 它价格昂贵，不过由此带来的精度对工业用途而言相当可观。

whether.en: The committee will decide next month whether the study should continue.
whether.zh: 委员会将于下月决定这项研究是否应当继续。

whether.en: Researchers disagree about whether the observed trend reflects genuine structural change.
whether.zh: 研究者们对于观察到的趋势是否反映了真正的结构性变化存在分歧。

whether.en: We must clarify whether participants were told the true purpose of the study.
whether.zh: 我们必须澄清参与者是否被告知了研究的真实目的。

while.en: While the theory explains the data, it offers little guidance for practitioners.
while.zh: 虽然该理论解释了这些数据，却几乎无法为实践者提供指导。

while.en: The sensor recorded pressure while the specimen cooled steadily in the chamber.
while.zh: 当样本在腔室中持续冷却时，传感器记录下了压力值。

while.en: While earlier studies focused on cost, this model emphasizes long-term durability.
while.zh: 尽管早期研究关注成本，这一模型则强调长期的耐用性。

yet.en: The device is small, yet it can process data faster than older systems.
yet.zh: 该装置体积很小，却能比旧系统更快地处理数据。

yet.en: She completed the analysis, yet several questions about the raw data remain.
yet.zh: 她完成了分析，然而关于原始数据仍有若干问题尚未解决。

yet.en: The paper has been widely cited, yet it has attracted little criticism from specialists.
yet.zh: 这篇论文被广泛引用，然而很少受到专家的批评。

since.en: Since the dataset was rebuilt last year, the analysis has become far more reliable.
since.zh: 自去年重建数据集以来，这项分析变得可靠得多。

since.en: Since funding was withdrawn, the laboratory has closed two of its research divisions.
since.zh: 由于经费被撤回，该实验室已经关闭了两个研究部门。

since.en: Researchers have debated the effect since the first measurements were published in 1998.
since.zh: 自 1998 年首次测量结果发表以来，研究者们一直在争论这一效应。

integrate.en: The platform integrates data from sensors, satellites, and field observations.
integrate.zh: 该平台整合了来自传感器、卫星和野外观测的数据。

integrate.en: Teachers must integrate these findings into the existing curriculum.
integrate.zh: 教师必须把这些研究发现融入现有课程之中。

integrate.en: Students who integrate theory with practice often produce stronger final dissertations.
integrate.zh: 把理论与实践相结合的学生往往能写出更有力的毕业论文。

isolate.en: Researchers isolated the chemical compound to determine its exact molecular structure.
isolate.zh: 研究人员分离出该化合物，以确定其确切的分子结构。

isolate.en: The design isolates age as a variable, allowing its effect to be measured directly.
isolate.zh: 该设计将年龄作为一个变量单独分离出来，从而可以直接测量其影响。

isolate.en: Public health officials worked to isolate the affected district and contain the outbreak.
isolate.zh: 公共卫生官员设法隔离了受影响地区，控制住了疫情。

formulate.en: The research team formulated a new hypothesis about how memories are stored.
formulate.zh: 研究团队就记忆如何储存提出了一个新的假设。

formulate.en: The committee formulated clear guidelines for the ethical review of clinical trials.
formulate.zh: 该委员会制定了临床试验伦理审查的明确准则。

formulate.en: Economists formulated the argument that markets fail under certain information conditions.
formulate.zh: 经济学家提出了这样的论断：在某些信息条件下市场会失灵。

derive.en: The authors derived their estimates from twelve years of national survey data.
derive.zh: 作者从 12 年的全国调查数据中得出了这些估计。

derive.en: Many English words derive from Latin roots through French intermediaries.
derive.zh: 许多英语词汇经由法语中介而源自拉丁词根。

derive.en: The team derived a simple formula for predicting peak demand in winter.
derive.zh: 团队推导出了一个预测冬季需求峰值的简单公式。

exhibit.en: The museum will exhibit forty watercolors by Chinese artists of the 1930s.
exhibit.zh: 博物馆将展出中国 1930 年代艺术家的 40 幅水彩画。

exhibit.en: The results exhibit a clear bias toward urban respondents in every region studied.
exhibit.zh: 研究结果显示，在所研究的每个地区，结果都明显偏向城市受访者。

exhibit.en: Rare manuscripts from the fifteenth century are currently exhibited in the main hall.
exhibit.zh: 15 世纪的珍贵手稿目前正在主厅展出。

allocate.en: The ministry allocated additional funds to rural health clinics last quarter.
allocate.zh: 该部门上季度向乡村卫生诊所拨付了额外资金。

allocate.en: Time must be allocated carefully when several urgent tasks compete for attention.
allocate.zh: 当多项紧急任务争夺注意力时，必须谨慎分配时间。

allocate.en: The committee allocated most experimental equipment to the two chemistry laboratories.
allocate.zh: 委员会将大部分实验设备分配给了那两个化学实验室。

aggregate.en: We aggregate responses from all participants before conducting the statistical analysis.
aggregate.zh: 我们在进行统计分析前汇总了所有参与者的回答。

aggregate.en: In aggregate, the two studies suggest a modest positive effect.
aggregate.zh: 总体来看，这两项研究表明存在轻微的正面效应。

aggregate.en: The researchers aggregated regional data into a single national estimate.
aggregate.zh: 研究人员将各地区数据汇总为一个全国性估计值。

simulate.en: The software simulates airflow around the vehicle at various speeds.
simulate.zh: 该软件模拟车辆在不同速度下的气流情况。

simulate.en: Researchers simulated the market to test the policy's likely effects.
simulate.zh: 研究人员模拟了市场，以检验该政策可能产生的影响。

simulate.en: A laboratory model was used to simulate deep-ocean pressure conditions.
simulate.zh: 利用实验室模型模拟深海压力条件。

synthesize.en: The review synthesizes evidence from over sixty independent clinical studies.
synthesize.zh: 这篇综述综合了六十多项独立临床研究的证据。

synthesize.en: The author synthesizes theory, historical evidence, and quantitative data into a coherent argument.
synthesize.zh: 作者将理论、历史证据和定量数据综合成一篇连贯的论述。

synthesize.en: The chemist synthesized the compound from readily available starting materials.
synthesize.zh: 化学家以易得的原料合成了该化合物。

differentiate.en: Researchers must differentiate correlation from genuine causation in the data.
differentiate.zh: 研究人员必须区分数据中的相关性与真正的因果关系。

differentiate.en: The new model differentiates clearly between diagnostic and predictive indicators.
differentiate.zh: 新模型清楚地区分了诊断性指标与预测性指标。

differentiate.en: Companies rely on distinctive branding to differentiate their products from competitors.
differentiate.zh: 企业依靠独特的品牌定位来使其产品有别于竞争对手的产品。

correlate.en: Sleep quality correlates strongly with memory performance in older adults.
correlate.zh: 睡眠质量与老年人的记忆表现有很强的相关性。

correlate.en: The researchers correlated test scores with hours of daily revision.
correlate.zh: 研究人员把测试成绩与每天复习的小时数进行了相关分析。

correlate.en: Rising temperatures correlate closely with declining agricultural yields in the region.
correlate.zh: 气温上升与该地区农业产量下降密切相关。

replicate.en: An independent team replicated the experiment and obtained nearly identical results.
replicate.zh: 一个独立团队复现了该实验，得到了几乎完全相同的结果。

replicate.en: The findings were replicated across four laboratories in three different countries.
replicate.zh: 这些发现在三个不同国家的四所实验室中得到了复现。

replicate.en: Scientists must replicate their results before drawing broad scientific conclusions.
replicate.zh: 科学家在得出广泛科学结论之前必须复现自己的结果。

refine.en: The team refined the model after noticing systematic errors in the predictions.
refine.zh: 团队在发现预测存在系统性误差后改进了模型。

refine.en: Further analysis refined our understanding of how the catalyst actually works.
refine.zh: 进一步的分析细化了我们对该催化剂实际工作机制的理解。

refine.en: The editorial staff refined the wording to make the conclusion less ambiguous.
refine.zh: 编辑人员润色了措辞，使结论不再那么含糊。

regulate.en: New legislation seeks to regulate the marketing of data-intensive medical devices.
regulate.zh: 新的立法旨在规范数据密集型医疗器械的销售。

regulate.en: A feedback loop automatically regulates the temperature inside the incubation chamber.
regulate.zh: 一个反馈回路自动调节孵化室内的温度。

regulate.en: Careful policy is needed to regulate the use of genetic information.
regulate.zh: 需要谨慎的政策来规范遗传信息的使用。

retrieve.en: Students can retrieve archived articles through the university library database.
retrieve.zh: 学生可以通过大学图书馆数据库检索存档文章。

retrieve.en: The software retrieves relevant passages automatically as the researcher types a query.
retrieve.zh: 当研究人员输入查询时，软件会自动检索出相关段落。

retrieve.en: Emergency crews retrieved the missing hikers within six hours.
retrieve.zh: 救援队在六小时内找到了失踪的徒步者。
